set.body:
From the reviews of 9282a0cf8 and 7115998ac (S3d-1, source-identity-graph/v2), all fail closed:
1. ReferentMention.anchored admits a dialogue mention on the picture stream; the v2 row then reads origin dialogue, stream picture, which the schema refuses, so one bad mention costs the whole graph. Refuse it in SourceIdentity.mention() with a court.
2. The edition block is copied from raw input (field(edition...)); emit timebase, start and end from the built bundle.
3. Court for a contested-class relation row: relationsOf uses the mention-level relation, which can say Distinct under a class id while distinct and ADR 0028 section 2 treat any pair with a contested class as unresolved. Unreachable until a distinctness input exists; add the court with that input.
4. The part check of ADR 0028 section 2 belongs to the S3d-2 reader (part is only inside the edition id).
5. The contested exclusion and non-empty distinct have no killing test for the same reason as 3.
set.title: S3d-1 follow-ups: dialogue on picture, edition from bundle, contested-class courts
